about: The migrated area of the gwz-git boundary guard (convergence plan step 5.5; Git boundary plan D-G section 6; read check_filesystem_boundary.py's docstring). `zero`: files and directories the moves of steps 5.2 and 5.3 created, rewrote clean or replaced; no production git2 token may appear in them (a path that no longer exists stays retired). `exceptions`: files those moves rewrote that still hold git2 for a row that has not moved, each with the exact count of git2 tokens, the rows, what the uses are, when the entry can go, and the date it was recorded. A count may fall (lower the entry, delete it at zero) and never rise; a new exception is a reviewed act. Paths are relative to gwz-core. Counts are the checker's token counts (comments, strings and test-only items excluded), not grep lines.

exceptions.responsibility: repo_head(&git2::Repository), kept as a delegation to gwz-git's head for callers that hold a native handle: G3 branch_list, branch_create, branch_delete and switch_branch (gitbackend/refs.rs), G10 recovery_support.rs:358 and merge_support.rs:42; find_remote; staged_statuses and unstaged_statuses and verify_checkout_state (G3's self-verify with its own status flags); git_error, core's translation of a git2::Error for the rows still in core
exceptions.exit: repo_head dies with the last of its G3 and G10 callers; the rest leaves with G3 (stage, checkout, branch) and G10 (merge, recovery)

exceptions.responsibility: open_repo (-> git2::Repository) and the helpers over a native handle that G3, G4a, G4b, G5 and G10 callers use: creation-time filter pinning, commit oid resolve and parse in the repository's format, the integration-state check, merge-result verification, ensure_branch_at_commit and the branch record
exceptions.exit: shrinks with each of G3, G4, G5 and G10; open_repo goes with the last native-handle caller

exceptions.responsibility: create_repo, reset_hard, checkout_commit, checkout_branch, stage_paths and stage_paths_allowing_other_conflicts
exceptions.exit: step that moves G3 (capability map section 2.4; not in plan section 4)

exceptions.responsibility: fast_forward and the branch functions: branch_list, branch_create, branch_delete, switch_branch
local-peer transfer (fetch_anonymous, push_anonymous, local push remote, tracking refs), fetch, push, ls-remote, clone and read_remote_file over libgit2 remotes
exceptions.exit: G4b with its step, G5 and G6 with step 5.4 after Phase 4.2

exceptions.responsibility: credential_helper_unavailable and credential_helper_timeout, two wrappers over a git2::Error for the transport binding
